# Fhea


> Expert-led NP certification exam prep and continuing education designed to help nurse practitioners succeed.


FHEA is a trusted leader in advanced nursing education, providing nurse practitioners with the resources they need to pass certification exams, maintain licensure, and grow professionally. With decades of experience and faculty who are recognized experts in their fields, FHEA delivers practical, high-quality content that makes learning efficient and effective.  


Our programs are built for busy practitioners—offering flexible online access, in-depth study materials, live learning opportunities, and continuing education tailored to the demands of modern healthcare. Whether you are preparing for your first NP board exam or pursuing ongoing CE, FHEA supports your success every step of the way.  


## Certification Exam


- [student membership](https://www.fhea.com/student-membership/): Access information about student membership options and benefits.
- [family np certification review](https://www.fhea.com/np-certification-exam-review/family/): Review resources and preparation materials for the Family NP certification exam
- [AGPCNP review course](https://www.fhea.com/np-certification-exam-review/adult-gerontology-primary-care/): Comprehensive AGPCNP review and preparation materials for NP certification exam.
- [psychiatric mental health NP certification review](https://www.fhea.com/np-certification-exam-review/psychiatric-mental-health/): Review resources and prep materials for the PMHNP certification exam.
- [adult-gerontology acute care NP certification](https://www.fhea.com/np-certification-exam-review/adult-gerontology-acute-care/): Review resources and prep materials for the AGACNP certification exam.
- [emergency nurse practitioner programs](https://www.fhea.com/np-certification-exam-review/emergency/): Review resources and prep materials for the emergency nurse practitioner certification exam.
- [women’s health nurse practitioner program](https://www.fhea.com/np-certification-exam-review/womens-health/): Review resources and prep materials for the WHNP certification exam.
- [pediatric primary care NP programs](https://www.fhea.com/np-certification-exam-review/pediatric-primary-care/): Review resources and prep materials for the Pediatric Primary Care NP certification exam.
- [livestream & in-person NP certification review](https://www.fhea.com/np-certification-exam-review/livestream-review/): Access livestream and in-person NP certification review courses for comprehensive exam preparation.
- [nurse practitioner student webinars](https://www.fhea.com/np-certification-exam-review/student-webinars/): Join free nurse practitioner student webinars for exam tips and preparation guidance.
- [fitzgerald bookstore](https://www.fhea.com/bookstore/): Explore the Fitzgerald bookstore for NP certification prep books and study resources.
- [free nursing podcasts](https://www.fhea.com/free-np-podcast/): Listen to free nursing podcasts with expert insights and NP exam preparation tips.
- [free pmhnp podcast](https://www.fhea.com/free-pmhnp-podcast/): Tune into the free PMHNP podcast for expert guidance and mental health NP exam prep tips.
- [np pass guarantee](https://www.fhea.com/fitzgerald-pass-guarantee/): Learn about the NP Pass Guarantee that supports your success on certification exams.
- [np certification q&a](https://www.fhea.com/certification-qa/): Find answers to common NP certification exam questions in our Q&A resource.


## Continuing Education


- [np memberships](https://www.fhea.com/np-membership/): Explore NP memberships for exclusive resources, discounts, and exam prep support.
- [np ce on-demand](https://www.fhea.com/np-continuing-education/on-demand/): Access NP CE on-demand courses to earn credits and advance your practice anytime.
- [np ce packages](https://www.fhea.com/np-continuing-education/ce-packages/): Save with NP CE packages offering bundled courses for continuing education credits.
- [livestream ce](https://www.fhea.com/np-continuing-education/livestream-ce/): Join NP livestream CE courses for real-time learning and continuing education credits.
- [live continuing education](https://www.fhea.com/np-continuing-education/livestream/): Attend live continuing education courses designed for nurse practitioners to earn CE credits.
- [nurse practitioner free webinars](https://www.fhea.com/np-continuing-education/np-webinars/): Register for free nurse practitioner webinars to gain CE credits and expert insights.
- [np conferences](https://www.fhea.com/np-continuing-education/np-conferences/): Attend NP conferences for networking, expert-led sessions, and continuing education credits.
- [np ce podcasts](https://www.fhea.com/np-continuing-education/podcasts/): Listen to NP CE podcasts to earn continuing education credits on the go.
- [grand rounds on demand](https://www.fhea.com/grand-rounds-on-demand/): Access Grand Rounds on Demand for expert case studies and continuing education credits.
- [fhea np talks](https://www.fhea.com/np-talks/): Watch FHEA NP Talks for expert insights, clinical updates, and professional guidance.
- [dea mate act education](https://www.fhea.com/dea-mate-act-education/): Complete DEA MATE Act education courses to meet requirements and earn CE credits.
- [scrubs and subpoenas](https://www.fhea.com/scrubs-and-subpoenas/): Explore Scrubs and Subpoenas for legal insights and guidance tailored to nurse practitioners.
